transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… things have been getting out of hand since I moved into this messed-up room. I’m up at night dealing with leaks or the heat, and then I’m dragging at work, showing up late, making mistakes I don’t usually make. I’ve been snapping at people too.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?

Yeah… I guess so. Since I moved into that busted-up room, I’m on edge a lot. I’m up dealing with the leaks or the heat, then I’m dragging into work late and messing up things I usually don’t. And I’ve been snapping at people more.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
I don’t know… not really sad, exactly. More just worn out and frustrated, I guess.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind and won't go away?
Not really… I mean, stuff bugs me, but I wouldn’t say there’s a thought that just keeps looping and won’t stop.
Have you had any panic attacks recently?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get worked up sometimes, but not like… a full panic attack, I don’t think.
Are there things or places you've been avoiding lately?
Not that I can think of. I mean… I’m not really going out of my way to dodge places or anything.
Do you feel like you have to do certain things over and over again?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve got my usual routines, but nothing I feel like I have to keep doing over and over.
Do you feel a strong need to check on things, like the leaks in your room, over and over again?
Not really. I mean, I might look once if I’m worried, but I don’t feel like I’ve gotta keep checking it over and over.
Are there any thoughts that you feel are intrusive or unwanted?
I don’t think so… not in that way. I mean, I get thoughts like anybody, but nothing that feels like it’s pushing in or that I can’t shake.
Do you find yourself worrying about things most of the time?
Not most of the time, no. I mean… I worry some, but I wouldn’t say it’s constant.
Do you have any thoughts that you try to suppress or get rid of?
No… I don’t think so. I’m not really trying to push thoughts out like that.
Do you have any recurring thoughts or images that disturb you?
No… I haven’t really had images or thoughts like that coming back and bothering me. Not that I’ve noticed.
Do you often find yourself worrying about everyday things like work, finances, or your living situation?

Yeah… mostly about the place I’m staying. That room’s been a mess—leaks, heat not working right—and I end up staying up trying to deal with it. Then I’m tired, late to work, and I mess up things I usually don’t. I’ve been getting short with people too.
Do you worry about things other than your living situation?
Not really… I mean, little stuff comes up, but it’s mostly that place. I don’t think I worry much outside of that.
Do you often worry about things beyond your living situation, like work or finances?
Not much, no. Work only kind of comes up because of the housing stuff, but I wouldn’t say I’m sitting around worrying about everything. Mostly it’s just that situation.
Do you often find yourself worrying about several different things at the same time?
Not really several things. It’s mostly that room. Since I moved in there, I’m up dealing with leaks or the heat, then I’m late to work and messing things up… and I’ve been snapping at people more.
Is your worry about your living situation interfering with your ability to worry about other things?

I guess… yeah, kind of. It’s like that room takes up all the space in my head. I’m up dealing with leaks or the heat, then I’m dragging into work late and messing up things I usually handle. And I’ve been snapping at people more. So I don’t really get to worrying about much else.
Do you think your anxiety and frustration would decrease significantly if your living situation improved?
Yeah… I think so. If that room wasn’t such a mess, I probably wouldn’t be up all night dealing with leaks or heat, and I wouldn’t be dragging into work late and snapping at people so much.
Do you think you would feel back to your normal self if your living situation was fixed and you weren't dealing with all these stressors?
I think so, yeah. It’s hard to say for sure because it’s not fixed yet… I’m still in that room, still dealing with repairs and the landlord. So it hasn’t really had a chance to be over.
Do you think your anxiety would go away completely if your living situation was resolved?
I don’t know if I’d say completely. It hasn’t really ended yet, you know? I’m still in the room, still dealing with repairs and the landlord, so I can’t really tell what it’d be like after.
